# spacelift_context (List Resource)

Lists every context in the account.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_child_spaces` (Boolean) With `space_id`, also list contexts in its child spaces, at any depth.
- `labels` (List of String) Only list contexts that have all of these labels.
- `name` (String) Only list contexts whose name matches this pattern. `*` matches any characters, and case is ignored.
- `space_id` (String) Only list contexts in this space.
